ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation Dream Job' — signed-binary DLL sideload from user-writable lure path
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Lazarus DreamJob / ClickFake / ContagiousInterview initial-access chain where a benign-signed third-party binary (PDF/Skype/VNC/coding-assessment lure delivered via LinkedIn ZIP/ISO/IMG) is launched from a user-writable directory and immediately sideloads a non-Microsoft DLL from the same lure folder, loading implants such as LightLessCan, BLINDINGCAN, MISTPEN or COPPERHEDGE.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","7zG.exe","WinRAR.exe","Bandizip.exe")) AND (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*:\\*\\*.exe") AND NOT (Processes.process_name IN ("setup.exe","install.exe","uninstall.exe","msiexec.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_id as ppid | join type=inner dest ppid [ | tstats summariesonly=false count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename process_id as ppid ] | where file_path!=process_path AND like(replace(file_path,"\\\\[^\\\\]+$",""), replace(process_path,"\\\\[^\\\\]+$","")) | table firstTime dest user process_name process_path file_name file_path file_hash
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus DreamJob — signed lure binary sideloading a DLL from the same user-writable folder
let LurePaths = dynamic([@"\Users\", @"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\"]);
let TrustedDllRoots = dynamic([@"\Windows\System32\", @"\Windows\SysWOW64\", @"\Windows\WinSxS\", @"\Program Files\", @"\Program Files (x86)\"]);
let LureProcs =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe","bandizip.exe","isoburn.exe")
    | where FolderPath has_any (LurePaths)
    | where ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !in~ ("Microsoft Corporation","Microsoft Windows","")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LureBinary=FileName, LureFolder=FolderPath, LureCompany=ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName, LureProduct=ProcessVersionInfoProductName, LureSHA256=SHA256, ProcessId;
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where FolderPath has_any (LurePaths)
| where not(FolderPath has_any (TrustedDllRoots))
| join kind=inner LureProcs on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ProcessId
| where datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ProcTime) between (0 .. 120)
| extend LureDir = tolower(strcat(substring(LureFolder, 0, strlen(LureFolder) - strlen(LureBinary)))),
         DllDir  = tolower(strcat(substring(FolderPath, 0, strlen(FolderPath) - strlen(FileName))))
| where LureDir == DllDir
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, LureBinary, LureCompany, LureProduct, LureSHA256, SideloadedDll=FileName, SideloadedDllPath=FolderPath, SideloadedDllSHA256=SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Lazarus DreamJob sideload — ASIM process/file correlation on Sentinel telemetry
let LurePaths = dynamic([@"\Users\", @"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\"]);
let TrustedDllRoots = dynamic([@"\Windows\System32\", @"\Windows\SysWOW64\", @"\Program Files\"]);
let LureProcs =
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("explorer.exe","7zG.exe","WinRAR.exe","Bandizip.exe")
    | where TargetProcessName has_any (LurePaths)
    | where ActingProcessFileCompany !in~ ("Microsoft Corporation","Microsoft Windows","")
    | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, LureBinary=TargetProcessName, LureCompany=ActingProcessFileCompany, LureSHA256=SHA256, TargetProcessId;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where TargetFileName endswith ".dll"
| where TargetFilePath has_any (LurePaths) and not(TargetFilePath has_any (TrustedDllRoots))
| join kind=inner LureProcs on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 2m)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, LureBinary, LureCompany, LureSHA256, DroppedDll=TargetFileName, DroppedDllPath=TargetFilePath, DllHash=TargetFileSHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus DreamJob Signed-Binary DLL Sideload from User-Writable Lure Path
id: 1a3e8b71-7c2c-4d3f-9a4b-9c9d8a2b1f4e
status: experimental
description: Detects a third-party signed binary launched from a user-writable lure path (Downloads, Temp, ProgramData, mounted ISO) loading a non-Microsoft DLL from the same directory — the signature initial-access chain for Lazarus Operation Dream Job / ContagiousInterview.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2023/09/29/lazarus-luring-employees-trojanized-coding-challenges/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dll:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '.dll'
  selection_path:
    ImageLoaded|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Public\'
  selection_loader:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  filter_trusted_dll:
    ImageLoaded|contains:
      - '\Windows\System32\'
      - '\Windows\SysWOW64\'
      - '\Windows\WinSxS\'
      - '\Program Files\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\'
  filter_ms_loader:
    Company:
      - 'Microsoft Corporation'
      - 'Microsoft Windows'
  condition: selection_dll and selection_path and selection_loader and not filter_trusted_dll and not filter_ms_loader
falsepositives:
  - Portable applications run from user profile (game launchers, dev tools)
  - Software installers that stage DLLs in Temp before MSI handoff
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:7 (@ImageLoaded:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Public\\*) AND @Image:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\users\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\downloads\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\*)) -@ImageLoaded:(*\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR *\\Windows\\WinSxS\\* OR *\\Program*Files*) -@Signature:("Microsoft Corporation" OR "Microsoft Windows") @ImageLoaded:*.dll
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ClassifiedModuleLoad ImageFileName=/\\(Users|Downloads|AppData\\Local\\Temp|ProgramData|Public)\\.*\.exe$/i TargetFileName=/\\(Users|Downloads|AppData\\Local\\Temp|ProgramData|Public)\\.*\.dll$/i
| NOT TargetFileName=/\\(System32|SysWOW64|WinSxS|Program Files( \(x86\))?)\\/i
| NOT FileCompanyName=/(Microsoft Corporation|Microsoft Windows)/i
| LureDir := regex_extract("^(?<dir>.+\\\\)[^\\\\]+$", field=ImageFileName, group="dir")
| DllDir := regex_extract("^(?<dir>.+\\\\)[^\\\\]+$", field=TargetFileName, group="dir")
| LureDir = DllDir
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, TargetFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus exploitation (CVE-2022-47966) — Java RCE spawning Magic RAT / QuiteRAT staging
ucs.description: Hunts post-exploitation of internet-facing Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus / Endpoint Central where the unauthenticated SAML RCE (CVE-2022-47966) gives the AdventNet Java process the ability to spawn LOLBins. Lazarus / Andariel (Onyx Sleet) sub-clusters used this exact path to drop Magic RAT, QuiteRAT, and the CollectionRAT family throughout 2022–2023 against healthcare, energy and defense targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_name) as child_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("java.exe","jspawnhelper.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat8.exe")) AND (Processes.parent_process_path="*\\ManageEngine\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\ServiceDesk\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\AdventNet\\*" OR Processes.parent_process="*ManageEngine*" OR Processes.parent_process="*ServiceDesk*") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","sc.exe","reg.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=cmdline "(?<flag_lol>(?i)(certutil\s+-urlcache|certutil\s+-decode|powershell\s+-(e|enc|encodedcommand)|bitsadmin\s+/transfer|curl\s+-o|whoami\s+/all|nltest\s+/(dclist|domain_trusts)))" | where isnotnull(flag_lol) OR child_proc IN ("mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
ucs.kql:
// Lazarus / Andariel CVE-2022-47966 — AdventNet Java spawning interactive shells / LOLBins
let ManageEngineRoots = dynamic([@"\ManageEngine\", @"\ServiceDesk\", @"\AdventNet\", @"\Zoho\"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","sc.exe","reg.exe"]);
let ReconCmds = dynamic(["whoami /all","nltest /dclist","nltest /domain_trusts","net group \"Domain Admins\"","systeminfo","ipconfig /all","tasklist /svc","query user"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("java.exe","jspawnhelper.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat8.exe","javaw.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (ManageEngineRoots)
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("ManageEngine","ServiceDesk","AdventNet","Zoho")
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| extend LOLBinFlag = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","certutil -decode","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","bitsadmin /transfer","curl -o","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","IEX "), "DownloadOrExec",
    ProcessCommandLine has_any (ReconCmds), "DomainRecon",
    FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe"), "ScriptHost",
    "InteractiveShell")
| where LOLBinFlag != ""
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, LOLBinFlag, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Lazarus CVE-2022-47966 — ManageEngine Java parent → LOLBin children
let ManageEngineRoots = dynamic([@"\ManageEngine\", @"\ServiceDesk\", @"\AdventNet\", @"\Zoho\"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","net.exe","net1.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("java.exe","jspawnhelper.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat8.exe","javaw.exe")
| where ParentProcessName has_any (ManageEngineRoots) or CommandLine has_any ("ManageEngine","ServiceDesk","AdventNet")
| extend NewProcLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where NewProcLeaf in (SuspiciousChildren)
| extend Intent = case(
    CommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","bitsadmin /transfer","curl -o","DownloadString","IEX "), "DownloadOrExec",
    CommandLine has_any ("whoami /all","nltest /dclist","net group","systeminfo"), "DomainRecon",
    "InteractiveShell")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, Intent
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus / Andariel ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus RCE Post-Exploitation (CVE-2022-47966)
id: 7e2b4d09-3c11-4d4a-8e3a-2b0b3c5d6a9f
status: experimental
description: Detects a Java / Tomcat process belonging to Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, Endpoint Central or AdventNet spawning a Windows shell, script host, or recon LOLBin — the post-exploit chain observed for CVE-2022-47966 leading to Magic RAT, QuiteRAT and CollectionRAT.
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/lazarus-quiterat/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-47966
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\jspawnhelper.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\tomcat8.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
  selection_product:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\ManageEngine\'
      - '\ServiceDesk\'
      - '\AdventNet\'
      - '\Zoho\'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate ManageEngine admin scripts shelling out for diagnostics (rare; tune by hostname/user)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\java.exe OR *\\Java.exe OR *\\jspawnhelper.exe OR *\\tomcat9.exe OR *\\tomcat8.exe OR *\\javaw.exe) (@ParentImage:(*\\ManageEngine\\* OR *\\manageengine\\* OR *\\ServiceDesk\\* OR *\\servicedesk\\* OR *\\AdventNet\\* OR *\\adventnet\\* OR *\\Zoho\\*) OR @ParentCommandLine:(*ManageEngine* OR *ServiceDesk* OR *AdventNet*)) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(java|jspawnhelper|tomcat[89]|javaw)\.exe$/i
| ParentImageFileName=/\\(ManageEngine|ServiceDesk|AdventNet|Zoho)\\/i OR ParentCommandLine=/(ManageEngine|ServiceDesk|AdventNet)/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|whoami|nltest|net1?|systeminfo|tasklist|sc|reg)\.exe$/i
| Intent := if(regex("(?i)(certutil\\s+-urlcache|-EncodedCommand|-enc\\s|bitsadmin\\s+/transfer|curl\\s+-o|DownloadString|IEX\\s)", field=CommandLine), then="DownloadOrExec", else=if(regex("(?i)(whoami\\s+/all|nltest\\s+/(dclist|domain_trusts)|net\\s+group|systeminfo)", field=CommandLine), then="DomainRecon", else="InteractiveShell"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, Intent], function=count())
